name: Shinsei ni Shite Okasubekarazu
original_name: 神聖にして侵すべからず
source:
There is a mansion surrounded by walls in a street situated in a corner of the city. Ruha lives inside this tiny Falkensleben Kingdom, which only contains her and two others: Hayato and his mother Yoshino. Hayato takes care of everything from waking Ruha up in the morning to cooking and cleaning. He feels that it is the least he could do for a girl that is alone. However, as summer approaches, both of them and the small kingdom all gradually begin to change.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
城市一隅的街道上，有一座被围墙环绕的宅邸。瑠波住在这个小小的法肯斯莱本王国中，王国里只有她、隼人和隼人的母亲芳乃。隼人从早上叫瑠波起床，到做饭、打扫，全都一手包办。他觉得，这是自己至少能为孤身一人的女孩做到的事。然而，随着夏日临近，两人以及这个小王国都开始慢慢改变。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/10/01/october-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
